rounds.text: Rishi Techtex Ltd trades at a notable discount across multiple valuation metrics, offering a price-to-book ratio of 0.76x on a book value of ₹ 51.4 against a share price of ₹ 39.1 [E2]. This mispricing is further highlighted by a conservative P/E of 12.7x [E1] and an EV/EBITDA of 5.73x, both sitting well below sector benchmarks of 21.22x and 11.89x respectively [E6, E11]. Underlying business momentum shows robust top-line expansion, evidenced by a trailing twelve-month sales growth of 25% [E17] and multi-year sales uptrends supported by strong compounded profit growth of 43% over 5 years and 34% over 3 years [E19, E20, E55]. Cash generation remains exceptionally sound, with an operating cash flow of Rs 7 Cr in March 2026 driving a cash conversion ratio of 3.50x, ensuring reported profits are fully backed by cash [E34, E35]. Furthermore, insider confidence is visibly strengthening as promoters have increased their stake by 7.53 percentage points to 41.98% in Sep 2026 from 34.45% in Dec 2023 [E40]. Conceded: free cash flow was negative at Rs -0 Cr in March 2026 [E36], and the company currently offers a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4].
